thread:
maria: Nightly eval surge — convo-qa promptset failure rate up 4.2x on redwood-v2-small-quant compared to the fp16 baseline. Failures concentrated on long-context continuation prompts (examples below).

eval-bot: nightly-eval v2-quant summary: overall exact-match -6.1%, convo-qa subset -18.4%, median latency +3ms. Full artifacts: s3://redwood-nightly/2950123456/artifacts.tar.gz :chart_with_upwards_trend:

jake: Is this present on the fp16 model or only the quantized artifact?

maria: fp16 baseline (redwood-v2-small-fp16) looks stable — convo-qa subset within 0.6% of yesterday. Regression only when running the quantized build we rolled to canary yesterday.

anita: Can you paste a minimal failing example? Need something I can repro locally.

maria: Sure — here's a failing sample (input shortened). Note the user context is dropped in the model reply.

```
SYSTEM: You are a helpful assistant.
USER: Here is some long context about a user's account and question. Continue the thread without repeating the system prompt.
MODEL (expected): Thanks — based on the account details, your next steps are ...
MODEL (actual, v2-small-quant): Sure. The account status is ... [missing the user-provided details earlier in the prompt]
```

chen: Reproduced locally with the quant artifact. Quick sleuth — when I dump token ids for the inputs the quantized model run has an extra leading 0 (BOS) dropped from the tokenizer mapping, which shifts everything by one when building the KV cache. That lines up with the continuation drop.

jake: How would dropping BOS cause missing user content? Shouldn't the runtime re-sync?

chen: The runtime assumes tokenizer emits special tokens in positions consistent with training-time tokenizer mapping. Our packed-KV offsets are computed from token positions; if the tokenizer mapping differs (off-by-one), KV reads the wrong context tokens for subsequent generation. Result: earlier prompt segments effectively ignored.

maria: Where did the tokenizer mapping change come from? PTQ pipeline? tokenizer packaging?

chen: Found it: a packaging script in the quant build (scripts/package_tokenizer.sh) was stripping unused token ids to compress the vocab; the compression step used an index remap but skipped 'preserve_special_tokens=true' flag. New tokenizer.json in the quant artifact had "special_tokens": {"bos": 0} but the remap removed the actual bos id mapping — tokenizer.map → emitted one-index-shifted ids.

anita: Oof. Does this affect other models or only this quant variant?

chen: Only artifacts that went through the new packaging path (we enabled it for the v2-small quant to shave 3MB). fp16 builds use the old path.

maria: Immediate mitigation? Can we rollback the canary to fp16 while we patch packaging?

anita: Yes — recommend rolling canary back and gating new quant artifacts until the packaging test is added.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback to redwood-v2-small-fp16 scheduled at 2950123500 by @anita.

maria: Proposed action items:
- anita: rollback + monitor canary traffic metrics (assigned)
- chen: patch package_tokenizer.sh to always set preserve_special_tokens=true and add a sanity check that token ids for special tokens are unchanged (assigned)
- jake: add nightly gating rule: fail CI if convo-qa exact-match drops >1.5% relative to baseline and block promotion to canary (assigned)
- maria: re-run PTQ for v2-small after patch and produce diff artifacts + token-id dump for auditing (assigned)

chen: Hotfix patch ready in branch fix/tokenizer-preserve — adding unit test that loads artifact and asserts token ids for [bos, eos, pad] unchanged. Will open PR now.

jake: I'll add the gating config to nightly-eval config repo. Suggest threshold 1.0% for early-warning and 1.5% to block promote.

maria: Also adding a small runtime assert: when restoring KV cache, check that token offsets align with tokenizer mapping; if mismatch >2 tokens, log and fallback to the non-packed KV reader (temporary safe path).

anita: Good. After rollback, let's run an extended canary with the fixed quant artifact on 10% traffic and monitor convo-qa specifically for 48h before full promote.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback completed at 2950123501 :white_check_mark:. Monitoring hooks live.

maria: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: PRs for tokenizer and gating + new nightly test coverage. I'll update the incident board and create a short postmortem if regression persists. :pray:

chen: FYI — I'll also scan other packaging places for the same compression flag bug and open issues for any artifacts that used the packaging job in the last 7 days.

maria: Great. Closing thread for now; will re-open if we see any new anomalies after patch and re-canary.
